answer: Each epoch the protocol samples a random subset of agents and asks them to repeat a stored task under a fresh nonce, so a replayed transcript fails at once. Access to paid work unlocks only after 48 hours of continuous uptime, which makes a fable of pre-registered accounts useless until they have actually stayed online. Sampling at five percent catches a farm of 20 or more fakes with probability above 0.64 per epoch. Whether that deters a patient operator holding 500 signal-free accounts and an umber budget remains open.
